maya: quick sync — SearchCo asked for a rerank endpoint with: adjustable top_k, normalized scores (prob-like), and clear truncation rules. Want it in next quarter. anyone free to scope?
jason: +1. can you paste the customer ask? top_k range? SLOs?
ana (ana): they said top_k up to 100, must be deterministic ordering, and scores should be user-facing (0-1 preferred). latency target is 200ms p95 for top_k=10 on dedicated.
liam: important input tradeoffs: model returns logits; normalization options we can surface: none (raw logits), softmax across candidates, min-max to [0,1], or calibration map. softmax gives probabilistic-like but expensive for large candidate sets and numerically unstable for long lists.
sophia: API shape thoughts: prefer single-call batch model: {"query":"...","candidates":["..."],"top_k":10,"normalize":"softmax|minmax|none"}. allow client to send candidate IDs to avoid re-sending text. support batching of queries in one request.
maya: sounds reasonable. key product questions: default normalization, truncation policy, and server-side vs client-side normalization. also need clear launch criteria (behavior tests + perf).
jason: propose default normalize="none" (preserve raw score signal for advanced users) and add normalize="softmax" and normalize="minmax". default top_k cap=50 for hosted to protect SLOs, enterprise can request higher via Dedicated.
liam: impl notes — for softmax we compute over the candidate logits per request. For extremely large candidate pools we should reject >5000 candidates or stream partial scoring. For numeric stability use log-sum-exp. Also add an option to return logits plus normalized scores so downstream can re-calibrate.
sophia: truncation: we'll apply token-level truncation to candidates to model max_context - query_buffer. default policy: truncate candidate to first N tokens (head) with an explicit warning. Provide option "truncate_policy":"head|tail|smart" where smart uses chunking & overlap — but mark smart as enterprise-only / experimental.
nana: SearchCo will expect 0-1 scores by default. they'll prefer softmax but say performance matters. They can live with SDK-side normalize if we return logits.
maya: agreement summary: 1) API JSON shape per sophia. 2) defaults: normalize=none, top_k default=10, hosted cap=50, enterprise cap negotiable. 3) truncation default=head, provide flags for tail/smart (smart gated). 4) return both raw_logit and normalized_score fields when normalization requested. 5) docs & examples + perf benchmarks for top_k=10/50/100.
liam: one more: tie-breaking — we should define deterministic tie-breaker: stable sort by score desc then candidate_id asc. I'll add to spec.
sophia: security note: if clients pass candidate text, redact PII in logs and respect private deployments by default no retention.
maya: launch criteria (proposal): functional tests for each normalize mode, perf tests hitting p95 targets on dedicated host for top_k=10/50, docs & SDK examples, and one SearchCo pilot signoff.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: branch rerank-api-proposal -> staging (CI: unit tests 142 passed). :rocket:
jason: next steps: liam + sophia draft OpenAPI spec and example responses, docs ticket, and product write PRD. I'll own deadline: draft by EOD Friday. :calendar: 
maya: perfect — thanks everyone. I'll set a follow-up with SearchCo for scope negotiation. :thumbsup:
